_comment: PORTFOLIO PROJECT REGISTRY — the only file to touch when adding a project. Each entry points at a GitHub repository that follows the standard structure (documentation/project.md + documentation/modules.md + images/cover.png). All visible content (title, summary, category, technologies, cover image) is loaded automatically from the repository's project.md frontmatter. The title/summary/category/technologies fields below are OPTIONAL fallbacks shown only while a repository has not been published yet.

projects.title: Multistore retail sales consolidation
projects.summary: Automated monthly sales reports using Power Query to consolidate data from multiple regional spreadsheets into a single refreshable dashboard.

projects.title: Inventory Dashboard
projects.summary: Real-time inventory tracking dashboard with automated low-stock alerts and supplier performance metrics built in Power BI.

projects.title: Expense Tracker Automation
projects.summary: Automated expense tracking solution with categorized spending analysis and budget vs. actual comparisons for departmental cost control.

projects._comment: Demo entry: renders the bundled example documentation (templates/project-repository) so you can see the full pipeline working before your real repositories exist. Delete this entry once your projects are live.
